The `setSession` result, or null when no user/chat id is available.

## Remarks

Stores the key from [Ctx.methodSessionFreeVoice()](./gramstax.ctx.methodsessionfreevoice.md) via [Ctx.setSession()](./gramstax.ctx.setsession.md)<!-- -->. Subsequent updates of the matching listener type dispatch to the page's `handleSessionFreeVoice` handler (routing id=1) until the session is cleared.
